name: Validate each asset consumer contract separately
description: When one authored asset has inventory, held-item and placed-world consumers, validate the size, path, model and rendering contract of each consumer independently before bulk production or release. A server load or a correct PNG does not prove client acceptance.
conditions: One source design is exported to more than one runtime consumer
Consumers have different native schema, size or renderer constraints
tradeoffs: Requires a small client-facing pilot in addition to static/server checks
Exact dimensions and paths remain engine- and version-specific

evidence.description: Placed structural atlas was rejected as an item texture
